title: A judged case (issue 0075 A)
description: The cases themselves hold the owner's data and stay in plan/research/lab/cases.json (private). This file is their shape. The examples name no real source.

kind.description: title, reader_text, full_text, same_story, not_same_story, same_post, thread, tree_edge, continues, label, search, discover, voice, not_new, order, date, reader_link; never checked: layout, deploy, ops, source_doctor, mark_x_target

now.description: The state on main. A case marked pass that fails makes the runner exit 1.

why.description: One line: why it passes, or what it waits for

posts.description: The posts as the judge named them (prose allowed); `expect` names them as refs

note.description: The judged prose: what was seen, when, with which numbers

expect.description: Absent: the case is listed as not checked, with `why`

ref.description: A stored post: its address (url, else normalized address), or a source (handle, address or display name) with words of its title. Several posts at one address: all of them (`first: true` in a stories assertion takes the first seen).

assertion.description: One surface (checks/surfaces.py), a path into its answer (checks/paths.py) and one test: equals, not_equals, contains, not_contains, starts_with, matches, not_matches, at_least, at_most, rank_at_most (a discover suggestion's place, 1 first), is_null, has_post, lacks_post, count {of, equals|at_least|at_most}. stories takes together/apart (+ via), or roundup + of (+ is).

via.description: a parent_reason one of the posts hangs by: citation, address, copy, quote, thread, time, none
